leaf_cluster_summaries.summary: US initial jobless claims for the week came in at 206K, slightly below the estimated 210K, indicating a steady labor market.
Micron announces a $10 billion investment over 10 years to build a new memory research laboratory in the United States.
The Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Index surged to 47.4, its highest level since April 2021, while the prices paid component fell to 40.9.
Walmart's CEO reports continued growth driven by higher-income households and highlights a 70% year-over-year increase in customers using its AI assistant, Sparky, which drives higher order spending.
San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly states that the central bank's credibility is intact and notes that rising global long-term bond yields blunt their signal for US monetary policy.

assignment.selection_rationale: The shortlist prioritizes high-signal, low-saturation stories with clear structural implications. Walmart's quantifiable AI monetization offers a rare look at consumer AI adoption, while Micron's $10B R&D investment highlights the next phase of US semiconductor onshoring. The Philly Fed data provides a nuanced macro lens on growth without inflation.
